name: Orbiting — The Many Ways of Circling the Clit
summary: Circular motion is one of the most pleasurable techniques, but there's huge variety in circles. One woman's favorite circle can mean nothing to another because hotspots differ and even change daily. Two variables define how a circle feels: location (through the hood vs. more direct) and pressure level.
